locator: I q.46 a.2 ad 7: accidit huic homini, inquantum generat, quod sit generatus ab alio
interpretation: Reading A. The accidental being-moved is having been generated ('sit generatus'), a completed change in the past. It is contrasted with the impossible case of a present dependence on this man, the elementary body and the sun. The prima via's series is present (simul), so the passage leaves open whether a mover's present being moved in another respect is accidental. Only the pinned ST texts are covered; SCG I.13 is now pinned (AQUINAS-SCG-I-13-EN, a translation) but is not yet weighed here; the Physics commentary is not pinned (see candidates).
